recommendation.runtime: stock Photon SDK with publisher PyTorch fallbacks on GB10
recommendation.status: provisional choice from a small local diagnostic set
recommendation.existing_detector_alternative: RF-DETR boxes can feed adapter directly; normalized coordinates and full image required. Direct timing excludes detector and ingestion.

method.quality_selection: Use all returned masks as union; no ground-truth best-object selection. Point mask candidate chosen by model-predicted IoU only.
method.benchmark_resize: Input thumbnail to maximum 1024x1024, preserving aspect ratio. Annotated fixtures unchanged; large qualitative panel reduced from1672x941 to1024x576.
method.warm_definition: Report second repetition explicitly; also report every post-mask-load call because second repetition alone understates variation. No p95 claims from two repetitions.
method.end_to_end_scope: Local image plus actual Moondream grounding plus mask model. Excludes camera decode, transport, HTTP and UI; per-stage timings exclude saved artifact output.
method.quality_metric_flag: evaluate_mask always retains end_to_end_validated:false; actual grounder-to-mask execution is recorded but broad system validation is not established.

memory.caveat: CUDA allocator counters do not measure all process/shared memory; max observed allocated is a sample not a peak-allocated counter.

provenance.source: public datasets-server cached JPEG, same revision and dimensions as annotation

limitations: Three annotated targets; three additional qualitative examples; four distinct valid negatives in v2. Not representative of defense inspection.
Two repeated calls per case/mode are functional measurements, not production percentiles or sustained throughput.
Old MD2+Edge run used box grounding and old generation limit; max_tokens did not cap detections, warehouse emitted50 boxes before slicing3. Later runs use actual max_objects3 generation setting.
MD2 point+SAM versus MD2 box+Edge changes grounding skill, mask model and generation cap; cannot isolate each change causal impact.
MD3 Preview box+SAM versus MD2 point+SAM changes model and grounding skill, so not a controlled grounder comparison.
Native Moondream segment remains unresolved; this is a separate mask-model pipeline.
